title: Serotonin type-3 receptor antagonists selectively kill melanoma cells through classical apoptosis, microtubule depolymerisation, ERK activation, and NF-kappaB downregulation.
authors: Barzegar-Fallah, Anita; Alimoradi, Houman; Dunlop, Jessica L; Torbati, Elham; Baird, Sarah K
one_liner_zh: 该文研究5-HT3受体拮抗剂对黑色素瘤细胞的杀伤机制，涉及微管解聚和分子对接，但核心是药物细胞毒性，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Malignant melanoma is a highly metastatic tumour, resistant to treatment. Serotonin type-3 (5-HT(3)) receptor antagonists, such as tropisetron and ondansetron, are well-tolerated antiemetic drugs commonly used to prevent nausea caused by chemotherapy or radiotherapy. We investigated the anticancer effects of these drugs on melanoma cancer cell lines WM-266-4 and B16F10 with or without paclitaxel. We constructed IC(50) curves and performed Chou-Talalay analysis, using data obtained with the MTT assay. Flow cytometry and fluorescent microscopy were used to examine characteristics of the cell cycle, cell death and cytoskeleton changes. Protein levels and activation were analysed by western blotting and molecular docking studies carried out. Data were analysed by one way ANOVA and post hoc testing. Ondansetron and tropisetron showed selective concentration-dependent cytotoxicity in melanoma cell lines WM-266-4 and B16F10. The effect in combination with paclitaxel was synergistic. The drugs did not cause cell cycle arrest but did promote characteristics of classical apoptosis, including accumulation of subG1 DNA, cleaved caspase-3, mitochondrial membrane permeability and phosphatidylserine exposure. As well, the cytosolic calcium level in the melanoma cells was enhanced, phosphorylated ERK1/2 induced and NF-kappaB inhibited. Finally, the formation of microtubules was shown to be impaired in melanoma cells treated with ondansetron or tropisetron. Docking studies were used to predict that these drugs could bind to the colchicine binding site on the tubulin molecule. Antiemetic drugs, already given in combination with chemotherapy, may enhance the cytotoxic effect of chemotherapy, following successful delivery to the tumour site.
abstract_zh: 恶性黑色素瘤是一种高度转移性肿瘤，对治疗具有抵抗性。5-羟色胺3型（5-HT(3)）受体拮抗剂，如托烷司琼和昂丹司琼，是耐受性良好的止吐药物，常用于预防化疗或放疗引起的恶心。我们研究了这些药物在有无紫杉醇的情况下对黑色素瘤细胞系WM-266-4和B16F10的抗癌效果。我们构建了IC(50)曲线，并使用MTT试验获得的数据进行了Chou-Talalay分析。流式细胞术和荧光显微镜用于检查细胞周期、细胞死亡和细胞骨架变化的特征。通过蛋白质印迹分析和分子对接研究评估了蛋白质水平和激活状态。数据通过单因素方差分析和事后检验进行分析。昂丹司琼和托烷司琼在黑色素瘤细胞系WM-266-4和B16F10中显示出选择性的浓度依赖性细胞毒性。与紫杉醇联合使用时效果呈协同作用。这些药物未引起细胞周期阻滞，但促进了经典凋亡的特征，包括subG1 DNA积累、裂解的caspase-3、线粒体膜通透性和磷脂酰丝氨酸暴露。此外，黑色素瘤细胞中的胞质钙水平升高，磷酸化ERK1/2被诱导，NF-kappaB被抑制。最后，在昂丹司琼或托烷司琼处理的黑色素瘤细胞中，微管的形成受到损害。对接研究预测这些药物可能结合到微管蛋白分子上的秋水仙碱结合位点。止吐药物已与化疗联合使用，在成功递送至肿瘤部位后，可能增强化疗的细胞毒性效果。
